actual_plan.actual_returned_url_preparation: passed for all533 unique planned blobs against42 complete private/public directory observations; private signed URLs were examined in memory only

findings.finding: main excluded existing receipt paths before invoking download_one, making the existing verification branch unreachable and silently skipping corrupted or mismatched saved payloads.
findings.resolution: Every existing receipt/payload is now verified before pending items are selected. Focused test confirms a corrupted existing payload causes main to refuse without any network access.

findings.finding: HTTP failures lost actual status; successful HTTP responses rejected by header validation also lacked their actual200 status because metadata capture occurred too late.
findings.resolution: Capture actual status/redacted response URL immediately on opening. HTTPError retains safe code and redacted URL while its potentially URL-bearing exception text remains suppressed. Wrong-header and403 mocks confirm retained actual statuses.

findings.finding: Directory capture printed String(rejected reason), which could expose private URL-bearing exception text.
findings.resolution: Rejected captures now use a fixed generic message; no raw reason is printed.

findings.finding: Reading the script hash at batch completion can misidentify running code if the file is edited mid-run.
findings.resolution: Final helper captures EXECUTED_SOURCE_SHA256 once at module load and records it in each new per-blob receipt and batch summary. Earlier coordinator batch needs its own retained start-version/disposition; this review does not retroactively assign final code to it.

focused_tests.scope: Positive download; host/ref/path/fragment/userinfo guards; directory request and public/private mismatch; exact hashes/length/header/oversize; wrong response URL; actual403 evidence; redirect refusal; no overwrite; existing corruption and main resume validation; synthetic query redaction.

limits: No real network request was performed by this reviewer; the coordinator owns actual download receipts and final remote-byte closure.
This helper verifies blob bytes. Complete remote tree membership and native file modes must be independently reconciled by the separate full-tree/readback verifier.
The first pre-final coordinator batch is not retroactively attributed to this reviewed final helper; retain original invocation evidence and version disposition.
Private signed-URL observations are excluded from review artifacts and final delivery evidence.
No full OntoKin runtime, candidate source, Agent service or destination tests were run for this bounded review.
scope: Coordinator-side immutable GitHub raw-byte readback only. No candidate code, repository files, Git refs, credentials or runtime implementation were changed by reviewer.
verified_properties: Only download_url values from actual directory observations are used; no token lookup, password manager, credential file, global secret discovery or invented signed URL occurs.
Directory request URL, repository and immutable40-hex ref are matched to the plan; private/public path/SHA/size/type identities agree.
Raw URL requires HTTPS and exact raw.githubusercontent.com authority plus decoded repository/ref/path; fragments, wrong hosts, wrong refs and wrong paths are rejected. Every HTTP redirect is refused.
Expected lengths are finite bounded integers; each response read requests at most expected bytes plus1; complete byte length, SHA256 and Git native blob SHA1 must all match.
Output payload and receipts use exclusive creation; existing payloads are checked rather than overwritten. Failed actual requests retain distinct redacted failed receipts.
All receipt URL fields remove query strings. HTTP exception text is generic. The bounded batch summary explicitly does not claim complete publication.
